lines.en: Sideways is faster than forward.
Sand whispers under my shell.
Eight legs, one shuffling step.
Mangrove roots keep blocking me.
I follow the line of the tide.
The sand is hot. I switch sides.
I hold my claws up like flags.
The tide went out. I look for pools.
Walking sideways, I trip on stones.
My tracks run deep in the mud.
I walk around another crab's burrow.
Seaweed still hangs from my shell.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但从不迷路。
lines.en: I am slow, but I never get lost.
The tide is out. The road is wide.

lines.zh: 我把卵埋深些，再横着走开。
lines.en: I bury the eggs deeper, then sidestep away.

lines.zh: 前面有只海龟，我绕开它。
lines.en: A turtle up ahead. I go around.

lines.zh: 我在听潮水什么时候回来。
lines.en: I listen for the tide coming back.
Holding my claws up makes them ache.
Sand works its way into my seams.
I blow a small bubble.

lines.zh: 红树林的影子刚好盖住我。
lines.en: Mangrove shade lands right on me.

lines.zh: 海带的味道从水里飘来。
lines.en: Kelp smells drift in from the water.

lines.zh: 我在挖一个洞，藏东西用。
lines.en: I am digging a hole to hide things.
I should get back to the water soon.
A gull keeps watching me.
My shell shines in the sun.
I count the waves. One per wave.
My eggs are buried under this sand.

lines.zh: 静静站着，别人才看不见我。
lines.en: Standing still keeps me unseen.
I comb my feelers with one claw.
Your feet are blocking my path.
Is that kelp in your hand?
You crouched down. I do not trust it.
Your shadow stretches too far.
I am checking you for a net.
You are standing in the tidal zone.
There is seaweed on your sleeve.
I raise my claws out of habit.

lines.zh: 你站起来比我高出一截。
lines.en: Standing, you are a head taller.
Are you here to catch me? I pinch.
The shell cracked. It is soft inside.
Do not step on my legs.
One claw broke. I can still pinch.
That hit made me blow bubbles.
I shrink down into the sand.
It hurts, but the tide will cover it.
You crushed the rim of my shell.
I flee sideways. That is faster.
Sand is sticking to the wound.
Once I reach the water, I am fine.
Kelp. Kelp. That is kelp.

lines.zh: 你把海带放下，我数三下。
lines.en: Put the kelp down. I count to three.
That smell makes me want to breed.
I am not hungry, but I want it.
Hand me that green strand.
I will run sideways for kelp.
Do not tease me. My claws are quick.

lines.zh: 海带在水里飘，我看见了。
lines.en: Kelp is drifting in the water.

lines.zh: 给我海带，我带你去看卵。
lines.en: Give me kelp and I show you my eggs.
This smell is surer than the tide.
Shell on shell makes a hard sound.
You kicked my claw.
I got pushed one step sideways.
Do not step. My legs are thin.

lines.zh: 我们卡在同一个石缝里。
lines.en: We are stuck in the same crevice.
Sand flew up from the bump.

lines.zh: 我的钳子夹到你的靴子了。
lines.en: My claw caught your boot.

lines.zh: 退一退，我得把身转过来。
lines.en: Give me room. I must turn around.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我掉了一只腿尖。
lines.en: That knock cost me a leg tip.
You hit me hard enough to rattle.
Enough kelp and I will agree.
We have to bury the eggs first.
The sand must be loose to hide them.
Not during the rising tide.

lines.zh: 我的钳子会轻轻敲你的壳。
lines.en: My claws tap lightly on your shell.
Under the mangroves is safest.
The eggs go under wet sand. Watch.

lines.zh: 我们挖一个两个人深的洞。
lines.en: We dig a hole deep enough for two.
The tide will keep watch for us.
One clutch is enough.
My claw lifts a strip of seaweed.

lines.zh: 我捡了块亮石头，放回沙里。
lines.en: I find a bright stone and drop it.
This one is too slippery to hold.

lines.zh: 我把卵挪到更深的沙里。
lines.en: I move the eggs deeper into sand.
You dropped kelp. I am keeping it.
I drag a shell two steps and stop.

lines.zh: 钳子太小，捡不了大东西。
lines.en: My claws are too small for big things.
I stack broken shells at my door.
This sand is wrong. I throw it out.
I only collect what can be hidden.
Who stepped on my burrow?
Something is shifting beneath the sand.
I have my eye on that kelp.
You are close. My claws come up.
That gull is back again.
My target is a patch of wet sand.
Someone is turning over my eggs.
I saw a shadow in the water.
Your shoe crossed the tide line.
I need to guard this entrance.
My claws are open. Do you see?
I circle sideways, closing in.
I keep my eyes on your feet.
The sand shifted under me.
Wait until I count to three.

lines.zh: 我不先动，你最好也别动。
lines.en: I will not move first.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的洞上。
lines.en: Your shadow fell across my burrow.
I raise a claw so you back off.
At this range, one pinch lands.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩碎贝壳的声音。
lines.en: I hear you crushing shells.
My claw has your trouser leg.
That hit was only two points.
I pinch, and I do not let go.
My shell bumps you. It is light.
You just got twisted by a crab.
I charge sideways, claws forward.
I missed. Sand sprays everywhere.
My claw is starting to ache.
After this I retreat to my hole.
Do not underestimate two points.
I crawl out of the wet sand.
The first thing I see is mangrove.
The tide pushed me up the beach.
My shell is still soft.
Broken shells litter my birthplace.
My first step went sideways.
The waves sound very close.
Other eggs are buried near mine.
I raised my claws and tested them.
The sun dried my wet shell.
The heat is turning my shell red.

lines.zh: 从岩上摔下来，壳磕掉一角。
lines.en: I fell off a rock. A corner chipped.
Too deep. I sink and blow bubbles.
The blast threw me out of my hole.
An arrow is stuck in my shell.
That potion smell makes me dizzy.
I have not tasted kelp in days.

lines.zh: 雷劈在滩上，我的壳发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the beach. My shell tingles.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，也没有潮。
lines.en: The void has no sand and no tide.
